name: Eau fraiche

card.summary: A very dilute fragrance meant for light, fresh wear that adds a subtle scent to a grooming routine.

quick.overview:
Eau fraiche is a fragrance category with a very low concentration of scent oils, so it smells light and fades quickly. It adds a subtle clean scent to grooming without the projection of stronger perfumes.

A T Nation thread about colognes mentions a product sold as "Eau Fraiche" in a list of favourites. No research on it was found.
quick.how: Typically sprayed or splashed after showering for a light scent, and reapplied through the day as it fades.
quick.risks: Fragrances can irritate skin or trigger allergy in some people.

lead: Eau fraiche is a category of very low-concentration fragrance, lighter than eau de toilette, intended for refreshing everyday wear. As part of grooming, it gives a faint clean scent.
A 2010 T Nation forum thread on colognes includes a poster naming a product called Eau Fraiche and noting they had not tried its "pour homme" counterpart.[1]

angle.text: Users wear it for a gentle, fresh scent that complements a grooming routine without being strong.

paras: Forum members discuss colognes as part of grooming, and Eau Fraiche appears there as one named option.[1]
